title: Reusable? Can't use dishwasher...
text:
Reusable? Can't use dishwasher.... I thought these were a great idea..at first. I will say they seem to be leakproof but I haven't used for shrimp yet. These are not supposed to go in the dishwasher, so I don't quite agree with reusable. Maybe for non food items? I still have most of package unused after trying to wash them out.
I personally don't recommend them!
